sources.title: Building control approval for higher-risk buildings
sources.verified_claim: BSR guidance sets the building-control approval process for higher-risk building work and was updated in April 2026; process requirements do not imply approval for any sample parcel.

sources.title: Building control bodies and registered building inspectors
sources.verified_claim: The BSR collection identifies duties, registration and standards for building control bodies and registered inspectors; professional regulation is separate from project-specific compliance.

sources.title: Registered building inspectors: professional codes and standards
sources.verified_claim: Registered building inspectors must follow the current competence framework and code of conduct; current versions may change and registration class does not establish a candidate scheme outcome.

sources.title: Building control bodies: professional codes and standards
sources.verified_claim: Local authorities and registered building control approvers operate under BSR operational standards and professional rules; those standards do not substitute for a building-specific application.

sources.title: Building Safety Regulator disciplinary and sanctions procedure
sources.verified_claim: The July 2026 procedure explains BSR disciplinary and sanctions decisions for inspectors and approvers; enforcement governance is not evidence of candidate-site compliance.

sources.title: Building Safety Regulator building control approval application data March to May 2026
sources.verified_claim: BSR publishes aggregate application volumes, decision outcomes and determination times for higher-risk buildings; aggregate performance cannot predict an individual candidate's approval or timeline.

sources.title: Register your business as a building control approver
sources.verified_claim: Private-sector building control businesses must register with BSR to perform relevant work; registration enables regulated activity but does not certify a specific design or development.

sources.title: Building Safety Regulator enforcement policy statement
sources.verified_claim: BSR's enforcement framework covers the building-control profession and consistent standards for local authorities, approvers and inspectors; it is a regulatory context rather than parcel-specific evidence.
